# Z-Sync

> Z-Sync is an independent app that syncs your Zen Browser tabs and spaces to iPhone and Android over Firefox Sync. It is a separate product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of Zen Browser or Mozilla.

## What it is

- An independent companion app for people who use Zen Browser on the desktop and want the same tabs, spaces, folders and essentials on their phone.
- It syncs over Firefox Sync, using the user's own Mozilla account. There is no Z-Sync server in between.
- Changes travel both ways: a tab saved on the phone appears in the desktop browser, and the other way round.
- Free, ad-free, open source under the MIT licence.

## Facts

- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play).
- Zen Browser itself is a desktop browser. There is no official Zen Browser mobile app, and Z-Sync is not one.
- Z-Sync is not a Zen Browser or Mozilla product, and Mozilla does not endorse it.
- Sign-in happens on Mozilla's own accounts page. Z-Sync never sees the user's password.
- Sync content is encrypted on the device before it is uploaded.
